integrity: Proof is analytic; finite importance-sampling checker corroborates but does not establish the limit. Earliest source date is a public 2015 question about the same model; the cited full distribution appeared in a 2018 preprint.
scientific_limitations: The scalar area distribution and its small-area tail were already established; only the marked six-corner conditional limit is claimed. No finite-threshold total-variation bound or nonuniform-side extension. Independent historical and mathematical validation not performed.
title: Six-corner logarithmic–Dirichlet shape law for small side-inscribed triangle areas
